results.title: The Girl in the Garage: The Laura Cowan Story
results.original_title: The Girl in the Garage: The Laura Cowan Story
results.overview: After her husband's arrest, Laura's family finds shelter with a friend, but it becomes a trap of abuse. Despite discovering other victims, Laura remains hopeful, documenting everything until she can alert authorities and escape.

results.title: Matilija
results.overview: MARTY, AN OBITUARY WRITER IN LOS ANGELES, AND HIS BROTHER GEORGE HAVEN’T SPOKEN SINCE THEIR FATHER’S PASSING IN THEIR YOUTH. NOW, NEARLY A DECADE LATER, DEATH UNITES THE TWO AGAIN WHEN MARTY RETURNS HOME FOR HIS MOTHER’S FUNERAL.

results.title: The Mime
results.overview: When a murderous mime starts a killing spree in a quiet neighborhood, an already injured teenager must survive his onslaught of terror.

results.title: Plop
results.overview: In a world where everyone has a partner, a woman from the secluded society of rejected singles, known as the Leftovers, takes a bold leap of faith on a revolutionary new dating app, risking everything for one last chance at love.

results.title: Three Days of Fish
results.overview: Just as he does every year, Gerrie flies from sunny Portugal for a three-day visit to the Netherlands, the drab country of his birth. He has his usual errands to run and he visits his doctor for his annual check-up, accompanied by his eccentric grown-up son, Dick.

results.title: Ravage Love
results.overview: Secrets unravel, obsession takes root, and betrayal ignites a fury no one saw coming when a woman's shattered heart triggers a quest for revenge.

results.title: Coldplay: A Film for the Future
results.original_title: Coldplay: A Film for the Future
results.overview: The visual accompaniment to Coldplay’s No 1 album Moon Music, created by over 150 different visual artists from 45 countries. Each artist was given a handful of music snippets from Moon Music and asked to create corresponding visuals. There were no rules or guidelines, and no knowledge of other artists’ creations.

results.title: Ωmenahje
results.overview: Cinematic icons collide in the fake medieval alleyways of Barcelona.

results.title: Paris Opera Ballet: Sylvia
results.overview: Fauns, dryads and shepherds: such is the bucolic world inhabited by Sylvia, the nymph of Diana, goddess of the hunt. Compelled to remain chaste, will she have to renounce her love for Aminta, just as Diana had to sacrifice her passion for Endymion? Originally conceived by Louis Mérante, Sylvia was the first ballet to be performed at the newly-opened Palais Garnier in 1876, but it is the version by Manuel Legris that is making its repertoire debut.

results.title: Kyllä isä osaa Lapissa
results.overview: The father and mother flee to Lapland to prepare for Christmas, but peace is at a standstill when the children tag along. When Jussi's new girlfriend Viktoria is revealed to be the millionaire's only child, the father does everything he can to make the best possible impression on the family's new daughter-in-law. As one surprise follow after another, the father must put all his “expertise” into play.

results.title: Un-Ex You
results.overview: Having had to fend for herself for most of her life, newly turned 30, Zuri has now become an independent and competent career woman who has put love on the backburner. But when she finds out she has a rare case of premature menopause - and may soon lose the ability to carry a baby - she scrambles to find a man with whom she can have a family of her own. After many attempts at different methods, she finds one last hope in her ex, ANDY. The only problem is that Andy has amnesia and has forgotten all about Zuri. Now, Zuri has to find a way to get him to fall in love with her all over again.

results.title: Castigo
results.overview: Raquel has a traumatic past. Twenty years ago, while she was still a child, she survived several exorcism sessions and was freed from evil. Now, as an adult, Raquel leads a peaceful life, devoted to the church and with a beautiful family of her own. However, when her son begins to exhibit the same terrifying behaviors, Raquel seeks help from the local priest to exorcise the traumas of her past once and for all and save her son.

results.title: Osamede
results.overview: In the Benin Empire of 1897, an orphan girl discovers she holds the power of the sacred Aruosa stone. As the Oba faces British conquest and betrayal from within, she must embrace her destiny to save the kingdom.

results.title: Make a Wish
results.overview: A remake of the French film "Maison de retraite": a hapless young man with a fear of old people must accept social relevant work in a retirement home

results.title: Degrassi: Whatever It Takes
results.overview: Creators, superfans, and stars including Aubrey Drake Graham delve deep into all things Degrassi in this engaging history of the Canadian show that changed teen TV.

results.title: November Fog
results.overview: After her father had an accident and fell into a coma, young Paula searches for a feeling of security. Desperately, she fights to save not only her father's farm - which has always been her beloved home - but also for his life.

results.title: One Letter
results.overview: A hearing man reunited with his deaf cousin at a family funeral. Long-simmering tensions and resentments come to the surface.

results.title: Складки
results.overview: In Suzdal, chiropractor Asya, suffering from impostor syndrome, and passionate tour guide Misha meet. He reveals the city's magic to Asya, and Asya falls in love. They spend the night together, hoping for a long-term relationship. But suddenly, Misha receives uninvited guests.

results.title: Little Shrew (Snowflake)
results.overview: A little shrew searches for Hope as she makes her way across a bombed-out city.

results.title: Oniria
results.overview: Four friends reunite at Felipe’s house after years apart. What begins as a night of laughter and beers slowly takes a sinister turn as they begin falling asleep one by one, trapped in strange dreams they can’t seem to wake up from. An innocent reunion becomes a descent into the blurred lines between reality and dreams.
